title: census.py apply keeps the artifact register in step and writes no address into a note
goal: census.py apply, before it runs its steps, sets the sha256 of each _artifacts.csv row whose file the result's edited_files names to the hash of the file as it stands, or refuses the part with exit 2 and nothing written; census.py apply refuses with exit 2 and nothing written a result whose outcome notes or gap and conflict texts hold a value the leak scan flags, and still applies a result that holds none

run:
import csv, hashlib, json, os, sys, tempfile, types
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import census, factdiff, kbcommon, kbroot
sha = lambda s: hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.makedirs(d + "/data")
os.makedirs(d + "/_census")
open(d + "/_root.md", "w").write(kbroot.root_md("zz", "ZZ", "internal", "planted root"))
open(d + "/_sources.csv", "w").write(kbroot.SOURCES_HEADER + "ZZ1,https://example.com/x,t,p,l,quote,2026-09-01,,,data/t.csv,\n")
open(d + "/data/t.csv", "w").write("a,b\n1,3\n")
open(d + "/_artifacts.csv", "w").write("path,source_id,sha256,zip_member\ndata/t.csv,ZZ1," + sha("a,b\n1,2\n") + ",\n")
log = d + "/_census/log.csv"
open(log, "w").write("id,url,kind,repo,pin,path,retrieved_utc,http_status,bucket,evidence,proof,note,used_in,outcome,outcome_note\nZZ1,https://example.com/x,live,,,,2026-09-01,200,CHANGED,e,,,data/t.csv,,\n")
before = open(log).read()
res = {"outcomes": [{"id": "ZZ1", "outcome": "updated", "note": "value changed"}], "new_rows": [], "superseded": {}, "gaps": [], "conflicts": [], "foreign_edits": [], "edited_files": ["data/t.csv"]}
json.dump(res, open(d + "/res.json", "w"))
census.KB = kbcommon.KB = d
factdiff.ROOT = kbcommon.load_root(d)
census.head_cited_lines = lambda ids: {}
census.drive = lambda *a, **k: (0, {})
code = census.cmd_apply(types.SimpleNamespace(log=log, group="data", from_json=d + "/res.json", dry_run=False), Counter())
fresh = list(csv.DictReader(open(d + "/_artifacts.csv")))[0]["sha256"] == sha("a,b\n1,3\n")
refused = code == 2 and open(log).read() == before
print("apply exit", code, "- register sha of the edited file is", "current" if fresh else "stale")
sys.exit(0 if fresh or refused else 1)

import json, os, sys, tempfile, types
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import census, factdiff, kbcommon, kbroot
addr = "release.manager" + chr(64) + "python.org"
def apply(note, gap):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    os.makedirs(d + "/data")
    os.makedirs(d + "/_census")
    open(d + "/_root.md", "w").write(kbroot.root_md("zz", "ZZ", "internal", "planted root"))
    open(d + "/_sources.csv", "w").write(kbroot.SOURCES_HEADER + "ZZ1,https://example.com/x,t,p,l,quote,2026-09-01,,,data/t.csv,\n")
    open(d + "/_artifacts.csv", "w").write("path,source_id,sha256,zip_member\n")
    open(d + "/data/t.csv", "w").write("a,b\n1,3\n")
    open(d + "/data/t.md", "w").write("# t\n")
    log = d + "/_census/log.csv"
    open(log, "w").write("id,url,kind,repo,pin,path,retrieved_utc,http_status,bucket,evidence,proof,note,used_in,outcome,outcome_note\nZZ1,https://example.com/x,live,,,,2026-09-01,200,CHANGED,e,,,data/t.csv,,\n")
    before = open(log).read()
    gaps = [{"topic": "data/t", "text": gap}] if gap else []
    res = {"outcomes": [{"id": "ZZ1", "outcome": "updated", "note": note}], "new_rows": [], "superseded": {}, "gaps": gaps, "conflicts": [], "foreign_edits": [], "edited_files": ["data/t.csv"]}
    json.dump(res, open(d + "/res.json", "w"))
    census.KB = kbcommon.KB = d
    factdiff.ROOT = kbcommon.load_root(d)
    census.head_cited_lines = lambda ids: {}
    census.drive = lambda *a, **k: (0, {})
    code = census.cmd_apply(types.SimpleNamespace(log=log, group="data", from_json=d + "/res.json", dry_run=False), Counter())
    return code, open(log).read() != before, os.path.exists(d + "/_gaps.md")
clean = apply("value changed", "a gap")
note = apply("the release manager is " + addr, "")
gap = apply("value changed", "ask " + addr)
print("clean result", clean, "| address in a note", note, "| address in a gap", gap, "(exit code, log written, _gaps.md written)")
ok = clean == (0, True, True) and note == (2, False, False) and gap == (2, False, False)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-rmp5zm5a (2026-10-22, operator accepted): fetch.py --offline failed after census apply changed privacy/gliner-models.csv (ST-vhtpgjb5) and mecm/log-files.csv and sql-views-compliance.csv (ST-bjwyl2bc) without their register hashes; test_leaks failed on a session note quoting the Python 3.14 release manager's address. Each was fixed by hand. The draft check reads source text. Premise run on main with two checks that call census.cmd_apply on a planted root (a register row with a stale hash, an outcome note and a gap text holding an address built in code): check 0 prints 'apply exit 0 - register sha of the edited file is stale'; check 1 prints 'address in a note (0, True, False) | address in a gap (0, True, True)', where the clean result is applied as it must be (0, True, True). The leak scan is kbpublic.file_hits with the allowlist of _tools/tests_allowlist.txt, the scan test_leaks runs. Docs: kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/web-sources.md (the map names both for census.py).
